# OphthaMCQ

> OphthaMCQ is an ophthalmology exam-preparation platform offering MCQ question banks, revision notes, and quizzes for postgraduate and fellowship ophthalmology exams (ICO/FICO, FAICO, DNB/MS/DO, PD-CET, FRCOphth, and subspecialty fellowships).

OphthaMCQ helps ophthalmology trainees and residents prepare for competitive exams through topic-wise MCQs, exam-specific past-paper style questions, and concise revision notes, available via web and mobile apps.

## Exams

- [ICO / FICO](https://www.ophthamcq.org/exams/ico-fico): International Council of Ophthalmology exam prep
- [FAICO](https://www.ophthamcq.org/exams/faico): Fellowship of All India Ophthalmological Society exam prep
- [DNB / MS / DO](https://www.ophthamcq.org/exams/dnb): Diplomate of National Board ophthalmology exam prep
- [PD-CET](https://www.ophthamcq.org/exams/pd-cet): Post Diploma Centralized Entrance Test prep
- [FRCOphth](https://www.ophthamcq.org/exams/frcophth): Royal College of Ophthalmologists exam prep
- [Fellowship](https://www.ophthamcq.org/exams/fellowship): Ophthalmology subspecialty fellowship prep
